title: AuthorizationGrantInput
description: Policy input for evaluating an authorization grant request.

user.description: The user requesting the grant, if applicable

session_counts.description:
Current session counts for the user. Only populated
when an authenticated user is involved in the grant.

client.description: The OAuth 2.0 client requesting the grant

scope.description: The requested scope for the grant

grant_type.description: Which grant type is being used

requester.description: Information about the entity making this request

SessionCounts.description:
Summary of how many active sessions a user currently has,
broken down by type.

total.description: Total number of active sessions across all types

GrantType.description: The OAuth 2.0 grant type being requested.

Requester.description: Metadata about the entity making a policy-evaluated request.

ip_address.description: IP address of the entity making the request, when available

user_agent.description: HTTP User-Agent header value, when available

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code derived from the IP address
